item.title: The UNTHINKABLE Is About To Happen To Stocks
item.description:
If you've been watching the market these last few days and thinking something feels off, I don't think you're wrong.
But I want to show you something I don't think most people have picked up on. Because right now, this market is telling you 2 completely opposite things at the exact same time.
On one side, you've got oil back over $100 a barrel, the bond market falling apart, and traders bracing for the Fed to actually raise rates. That's about as scared as this market gets.
